title: diploprora championii var. uraiensis
intro: Diploprora championii var. uraiensis, commonly known as Uraiensis diploprora, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is native to the tropical forests of Asia, specifically in the Philippines. The health benefits of Uraiensis diploprora include its potential to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, attributed to bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
